subject: Mythology
title: Karma: The Cosmic Law of Action
description: A quick win: understand Karma: The Cosmic Law of Action.

hook.text: Karma is not revenge. It is the law that every action creates a consequence that follows you across lifetimes.

buildup.text: Good deeds generate positive karma. Harmful actions create negative karma. Both carry into future lives.

discovery.text: In the Mahabharata, even great warriors suffered because of karmic debts accumulated over previous incarnations.

twist.text: Karma is not punishment. It is a teaching tool — the universe giving you exactly what you need to learn and grow.

climax.text: The concept spread to Buddhism, Jainism, and global culture. 'What goes around comes around' is karma simplified.

punchline.text: The universe keeps a perfect ledger, and the balance always comes due.

quiz.question: What is the Hindu concept of karma?
options: A system of divine punishment for sinners
A cosmic law where every action creates consequences across lifetimes
A form of prayer that grants wishes
